requiredFindings.title: D-9 substitutes an extrapolated row ceiling for measured admitted rows
requiredFindings.evidence: PROPOSAL-r6.md:559 requires measured inventory rows and canonical descriptor bytes against separate bounds; :591 requires snapshot2's admitted rows from SM-5, and :620 rejects estimated figures. D-9 instead divides 4 MiB by the observed average descriptor bytes per row and calls the extrapolation the snapshot2 row ceiling.
requiredFindings.impact: The observed descriptor does not establish an exact capacity for an unspecified larger population: row encoding varies with paths and other row content, and descriptor overhead is not a constant per-row cost. U-4 would therefore supply an estimated substitute for the required S-M term.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Record the measured snapshot2-equivalent inventory population and its exact row count, descriptor bytes, total bytes and bound standing from SM-5 for each required workload. Keep any average-based extrapolation explicitly informational and estimated, outside the required admitted-row term; alternatively provide an exact, separately reviewable admission/capacity derivation over an explicitly fixed population. Do not fill S_eff or choose later-owned parameters.

requiredFindings.title: The unit list does not cover every required large-workload pre-effect input
requiredFindings.evidence: PROPOSAL-r6.md:571 includes smithy-rs, rspack, deno and conditionally sui; :586-591 requires the S-M part for each workload, and :577 only excludes these figures from outcomes (A)-(C). U-3 specifies nine medium prepared entries; :112 mentions only Smithy and Deno follow-up graphs as information. U-4 does not explicitly account for the remaining large workload coverage and census inputs.
requiredFindings.impact: Completing U-1 through U-6 as written need not produce the required large-workload SM-11 coverage records and SM-13 site decomposition. The absence of an outcome dependency does not make those pre-effect inputs optional.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Give the units an explicit workload/figure coverage matrix including smithy-rs, rspack, deno and the S-P condition for sui. For each, identify the accepted exact S and host derivations, the labelled analysis/RSS coverage or substantiated unavailability, and the site observations/query mapping and formulas still owed. Assign large-workload census/coverage work before U-6. Preserve unavailable or partial coverage honestly; this correction does not require repository execution, native admission, unsupported quotients, or post-effect worker figures.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Distinguish workload source counts from analysed coverage in D-1
nonBlockingObservations.observation: The one-per-source fixture is an admissible explicitly synthetic benchmark convention, not a real-workload bound. However, Rust S counts all RUST3-LIM input subjects, while the accepted census REPORT.md:35-43 and :47 records partial or zero first-party coverage. Calling all S subjects analysed sources, or calling this the smallest graph implied by analysis, is stronger than that evidence.
nonBlockingObservations.recommendation: Name these workload input/source-count scenarios and carry the actual SM-2/SM-4 coverage beside them. Keep any future F/T or outcome explicitly conditional on the synthetic D-1 convention; neither this review nor the prior acceptance establishes a real-workload lower bound.
